historical_record.description: Built as a 15-storey steel-frame tower with a brick curtain wall.

Re-clad with green spandrel panels and restyled as a Midcentury Modern office tower; portions of the panel cladding have since failed, exposing areas of the original brick. It is a building altered wholesale into a later style.
